about_the_game:
Contents

The following items will be added directly to your account:

- 2,000 paid crystals

The following items will be sent to your crate:

- 3 Legendary Card Pack tickets

- 3,500 vials

How to Claim Items

Select Other from Add. Menus. Then select View DLC to claim your items.

Notice

- The Deckboost Bundle can only be claimed once across all platforms. This means that even if you purchase the bundle again on another platform, the contents will not be added to your inventory or sent to your crate again. Please be careful that you don't make duplicate purchases.

- The Deckboost Bundle can only be claimed once per Steam account.

- Crystals will be sent directly to your inventory.

- All items excluding crystals will be sent to your crate.

- Items sent to your crate will not have an expiration date.

short_description: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.
